releaseNotes:
## What's Changed

### 桌面端与跨平台

* 移除 KMP 桌面端，为 Tauri 桌面端迁移做准备 by @ChinsaaWei in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/251
* 重构 Tauri 桌面端并优化项目结构与算法 by @LanRhyme in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/272
* 新增 macOS BlackHole 虚拟音频设备支持 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/250
* 为非 macOS 平台补充 BlackHole 音频设备存根实现 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/253
* 修复 macOS 毛玻璃效果与 ONNX 编译问题 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/248
* 修复 Tauri 窗口拖动效果 by @tfr0305 in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/254
* 修复袖珍模式下的多项界面与交互问题 by @tfr0305 in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/259
* 修复系统托盘显示与隐藏问题 by @tfr0305 in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/270
* 修复 Tauri 桌面端的多项界面问题 by @tfr0305 in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/290
* 修复 Linux 白屏，并改善 NVIDIA 环境下的渲染兼容性 by @a2heng in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/292
* 改进 Linux 桌面透明窗口支持 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/commit/37b2d305bcf396b13cb1f77a702a3834e86b8ffc

### 主题与个性化

* 新增主题选择器、自定义颜色与 Material 3 配色能力 by @LanRhyme in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/commit/c0675557ae5069742d58330f48abdf4ed2d63adb
* 新增自定义 CSS 与毛玻璃效果，并优化界面动画 by @LanRhyme in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/commit/91496fcb37cef8a7fe4342d7212cc4336daf765c
* 优化主题生成逻辑，新增主题变体与多语言本地化 by @LanRhyme in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/commit/e31d50a3fd85feb1669590828b49c10ca6a22c6a
* 重构主题系统，新增系统强调色、主题商场与主题包管理 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/commit/d58568d80d545c7eb653b0acffbb61d127fa4dcf
* 完善主题商场的安装、切换与卸载操作 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/commit/bdf527bc0c92b23f81aedab7ea0ae72f91b72ee3
* 为插件市场与主题目录新增贡献入口 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/commit/838a5e3fb7c4a06a986eaacf94c81994590b1faa

### 音频、连接与稳定性

* 新增 PureVox AI 降噪 by @ChinsaaWei in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/278
* 集成 AEC7 声学回声消除 by @ChinsaaWei in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/279
* 简化 AEC 架构，并使用 WASAPI Loopback 获取扬声器参考音频 by @a2heng in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/280
* 支持 Linux AEC，并完善运行时恢复与构建流程 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/291
* 新增 Opus 弱网优化、通知保活与虚拟设备常驻，并修复 USB 绑定问题 by @a2heng in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/295
* 优化音频会话生命周期、内存占用与 FEC 恢复 by @sybxxx in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/289
* 修复连接错误导致的崩溃并优化端口输入逻辑 by @JF137575 in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/282
* 防止 GUI、CLI 与 TUI 模式并发切换 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/commit/bdf527bc0c92b23f81aedab7ea0ae72f91b72ee3

### 插件与扩展

* 新增完整插件系统，包括双运行时、Host API、DSP 节点、插件市场与开发工具链 by @LanRhyme in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/296
* 修复插件前端与 CLI 构建问题 by @tfr0305 in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/297
* 修复静音状态同步、调试模式崩溃与多项插件问题 by @tfr0305 in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/298

### 工程维护与文档

* 更新相关文档 by @WhatDamon in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/247
* 优化项目结构 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/249
* 修复 Unix 与 Windows 条件编译造成的依赖缺失问题 by @tfr0305 in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/257
* 清理并优化代码 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/263
* 重构模块结构并清理废弃代码 by @ChinsaaWei in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/275
* 回滚 PR #275 by @ChinsaaWei in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/277

## New Contributors

* @tfr0305 made their first contribution in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/254
* @JF137575 made their first contribution in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/282
* @sybxxx made their first contribution in https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/pull/289

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LanRhyme/MicYou/compare/v1.3.5...v2.0.0
